\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 206-208 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R211-first-pass-words-from-chapters-206-208}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a brick and metal.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a document, a birth certificate, a file, a printer, an address
  \item the haft-sin, a present, a tradition, a party, a musical instrument
  \item weather, ice, hail, shade, temperature
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A document? (\textbf{\fa{مدرک}}, \emph{madrak}.) A birth certificate? (\textbf{\fa{شناسنامه}}, \emph{shenâsnâme}.) A file? (\textbf{\fa{پرونده}}, \emph{parvande}.) A printer? (\textbf{\fa{پرینتر}}, \emph{printer}.) An address? (\textbf{\fa{آدرس}}, \emph{âdres}.) The haft-sin? (\textbf{\fa{هفت} \fa{سین}}, \emph{haft-sin}.) A present? (\textbf{\fa{هدیه}}, \emph{hediye}.) A tradition? (\textbf{\fa{سنت}}, \emph{sonnat}.) A party? (\textbf{\fa{مهمانی}}, \emph{mehmâni}.) A musical instrument? (\textbf{\fa{ساز}}, \emph{sâz}.) Weather? (\textbf{\fa{هوا}}, \emph{havâ}.) Ice? (\textbf{\fa{یخ}}, \emph{yakh}.) Hail? (\textbf{\fa{تگرگ}}, \emph{tagarg}.) Shade? (\textbf{\fa{سایه}}, \emph{sâye}.) Temperature? (\textbf{\fa{دما}}, \emph{damâ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 209-211 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R211-second-pass-words-from-chapters-209-211}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a nightingale and a crocodile.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a nightingale, a crocodile, a zebra, a lamb, a crab
  \item a radio, the media, an interview, the internet, a mobile phone
  \item cotton, wool, silk, a brick, metal
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A nightingale? (\textbf{\fa{بلبل}}, \emph{bolbol}.) A crocodile? (\textbf{\fa{تمساح}}, \emph{tamsâh}.) A zebra? (\textbf{\fa{گورخر}}, \emph{gurekhar}.) A lamb? (\textbf{\fa{بره}}, \emph{bare}.) A crab? (\textbf{\fa{خرچنگ}}, \emph{kharchang}.) A radio? (\textbf{\fa{رادیو}}, \emph{râdiyo}.) The media? (\textbf{\fa{رسانه}}, \emph{rasâne}.) An interview? (\textbf{\fa{مصاحبه}}, \emph{mosâhebe}.) The internet? (\textbf{\fa{اینترنت}}, \emph{internet}.) A mobile phone? (\textbf{\fa{موبایل}}, \emph{mobâyl}.) Cotton? (\textbf{\fa{پنبه}}, \emph{panbe}.) Wool? (\textbf{\fa{پشم}}, \emph{pashm}.) Silk? (\textbf{\fa{ابریشم}}, \emph{abrisham}.) A brick? (\textbf{\fa{آجر}}, \emph{âjor}.) Metal? (\textbf{\fa{فلز}}, \emph{felez}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
